plan.why: Lists every file under the theatre with its size: after a set, after history+get, after a watch that picks up a hand edit and is stopped with SIGINT, and after a second watch stopped with SIGTERM. Leftover .db-wal/.db-shm files, and whether the wal is zero-size or not, show whether each implementation closes the history store explicitly, and whether the main db file alone holds the data after a set. Because of the 12-step limit, history and get share one listing, and the SIGTERM watch, which has no edit of its own, is listed once at the end.
